g.title: cluster_svc
g.text: Shared services for the LLM agents

g.title: bus
g.text: • append-only log of every report, plan, decision, action
• routes each event kind to the agents that react to it
• dedupe and debounce · replay and audit

g.title: orch
g.text: • control loop: sense → plan → gate → act
• wakes agents · enforces step, time and token budgets
• falls back to the solver plan if no model is reachable

g.title: a_replan
g.text: • keep a unit unless a switch saves enough

g.title: a_gate
g.text: • match action to a policy clause

g.title: a_cop->s_mem
g.text: tools via MCP · screened by guardrails
